'''Acetwo5 Profit Profit Profit''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Acetwo5]]
* '''Published:''' 4 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Profit Acetwo5 LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Leia's Sporting Blaster (V), Bionic Hand (V), Redemption (V), Bright Hope (V), Chewbacca (V), Civil Disorder (V), Seeking An Audience (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Mains with weapons, and lots of reviving of characters.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (no section counts are given).
* Posted 'Battle Plan (maybe)' dested the Endor Effect Battle Plan, as listed in the Effects section.
* Posted Jabba's Palace / Audience Chamber dested Tatooine: Jabba's Palace / Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; Starport Docking Bay dested Spaceport Docking Bay; See-Threepio dested C-3PO (See-Threepio); Master Luke x3 and Ben Kenobi x2 are duplicates of unique characters, dested as posted.
* Original-era (V) cards: Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1); Leia's Sporting Blaster (V), Chewbacca (V) (Virtual Set 3); Bionic Hand (V), Redemption (V), Bright Hope (V), Civil Disorder (V), Seeking An Audience (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

I try to focus on retreiving Han fast, first or second turn. I put a lot of Lukes in here so I have a better chance of getting him first turn. I know I am missing some good cards, such as Leia Rebel Princess but im doing what I can with what I got. I also need to through in some more Hans, and I thin ill put in Tantive IV to beef up my space. I also need to change the space site I have in there. Kiffex had good activation and good drains so I through it in. This is the first deck Ive posted on GPN. Any suggestions would be most helpful :).
